name: Antigravity Remote Control & Web UI
description: Installs Google Antigravity CLI and Engine with support for Google Remote Control (antigravity.google) and local Ingress hub.

version.description: The Antigravity engine version to install (e.g. latest, 2.9.1)

enableRemoteControl.description: Enable outbound Google cloud proxy tunnel for access via antigravity.google

enableLocalInterface.description: Enable local Web UI hub server on port 52425 for internal Ingress / LAN access

hostname.description: Custom instance nickname for this devcontainer in the antigravity.google dashboard
